svg.text: S15 · Thermocouple readout and amplification
Thermocouple readout and amplification
Post-16 · ages 16–19
Supply measured thermocouple voltages through a stated source
resistance. Test loading and an amplifier interface. The model does not
independently reproduce thermoelectric conversion.
Your investigation
Record a prediction, follow the stated task and compare the result with
your prediction.
This activity
Supply measured thermocouple voltages through a stated source
resistance. Test loading and an amplifier interface. The model does not
independently reproduce thermoelectric conversion.
Getting started
Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
Explain:
Use an equation, a truth table or a state sequence to justify your
prediction. Include units and discuss the model assumptions.
The model predicts electrical behaviour; it does not replace real practical
measurements.
